instruction: From the Notes folder in Thunderbird, save the Word document attachment to a new folder called 'Email_Attachments' in your home directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new folder Email_Attachments in home directory and saving the Word attachment there. Evaluator checks both folder creation and file existence.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator checks both folder creation and file presence in the new folder
